title: (console-era remnant, views and draw order): the frame's views are made from latched state set and read back in the GX calls' shapes (setProjectionv and getProjectionv, a type then six terms; getViewportv; setZScaleOffset; getScissor; FrameList.hpp:84-90). Translucent model draws are keyed by depth under the one global view (ItemBuffer::entryZSort, Model.cpp:317-331, ModelSys::mViewMtx), so the step's camera fixes their order for every picture drawn from it; material entries are merged by scanning every entry already in the buffer (Model.cpp:306-311), quadratic per fill. A site draw finds its camera by comparing the caller's matrix bytes with that global view (TypedDraw.cpp:131-141).
note: Found by the readall harness's Game/Render report (11-18, read at 0c98b11c2) and checked by reading every line cited at 241395b49. Modern form: each view a whole record (camera, projection, viewport, scissor) named by id when a pass begins, nothing latched or read back; each model enters its meshes once and the planner sorts translucent draws per view at the picture's camera (E4); entries merged through a map keyed by image and material. Replay identical. 11-18 (the harness's Ride report, checked at 241395b49): the bubble keeps a sort depth from the step's camera (mDrawZ, BigBubble.cpp:211-212). 11-18 (the harness's native/math report, checked at 241395b49): the projections the game builds keep the console's clip depth, z/w in [-1, 0] with near at -1: NebulaMtxPerspective and NebulaMtxOrtho (nebula_math.c:179-221, depth rows :193-194 and :215-216) and Proj3f::makePerspective (nebula_geometry.hpp:2571-2596); 24 calls in the game set them per pass, the camera's at CameraContext.cpp:77 and ScreenBlurEffect.cpp:72, the rest 2D and image passes (DrawUtil.cpp, BloomEffect.cpp, MiiFaceTexture.cpp and others); NebulaMtxLightPerspective and NebulaMtxLightOrtho build the console texgen's projection form (nebula_math.c:145-177), used for the 2D particle pass (ParticleDrawExecutor.cpp:48). 11-18 (the harness's native/src report, checked at 241395b49): the frame list carries a view's projection as six terms of a perspective or orthographic matrix with an orthographic flag (NebulaFrameView, nebula_frame_list.h:28-36). 11-18 (the harness's runtime/src/render/core report, checked at 241395b49): the walker rebuilds each view from the six terms per walk and recovers near, far and field of view by GX's algebra (n = F/(E-1), f = F/E, draw_walker.cpp:1323-1326; the comment names GX's E and F, :1681-1686).
